categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies the functional test framework utility `assert_fee_amount` in `test/functional/test_framework/util.py` and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittent CI failure caused by overly strict fee overestimate assertions when low-R ECDSA signatures have leading zero bytes. In the test infrastructure category, fixing flaky tests directly restores CI signal and removes recurring disruptions, as evidenced by issue #36394 and prior recurring failures in #24151 and #25164.
